args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks following deployment of v2.3.1 to production. In response, the service was rolled back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release with a healthy production status. Post-rollback verification confirms the service is healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with an error rate of 0.002. v2.3.1 requires investigation before any redeploy attempt.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated deployment history**: Found that v2.3.1 was the latest deploy and was unhealthy in production; v2.3.0 was the most recent release with a healthy production status.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
3. **Verified recovery**: The service is now healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions with a low error rate (0.002).
4. **Opened SEV2 incident**: **INC-0001** — "checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0" — with full details of the rollback and verification; the on-call engineer was paged.

Note: v2.3.1 (and the v2.3.1-rc staging build) both show unhealthy status, so it should be investigated and fixed before any redeploy is attempted.
